podcast.body: Verboten created a music video of their performance in 1982, which is currently available online. "they even did a video of the band performing in 1982."

podcast.title: Tracy Bradford's Band
podcast.body: This punk rock band was formed by Dave Grohl's cousin, Tracy Bradford, when she was 14 years old, with its youngest member being a 10-year-old guitarist. "14-year-old Tracy was in her own punk rock band. It was called Verboten."
